motivation: 31B ends the new_string of some edit_file calls with the token backtick-comma where the string-closing token belongs; the call is refused and repeated until the run dies. One neuron that reads that state and writes the closing token would repair the call at its first wrong token.
hypothesis: The state before the faulty token is linearly readable in the last layer on tasks the fit did not see (held-out mean read-out 0.5 or more with hard-negative 99th percentile under 0.1), and the write makes the closing token the most probable one there without changing other positions.

folds.others: crc32 of the task id, modulo 2

config.selection_rule: max held-out ERR mean read-out with hard-negative p99 < 0.1 and mean >= 0.5
config.gates: held-out ERR flipped to the closing token >= 70%; held-out negatives with a changed top token <= 0.1%

env.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
